approach.title: Useful work. Clear steps.
approach.intro: A good project gives the owner something they can review, understand and own. Each step has a clear outcome.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: Agree the pages, content, contact route and scope in writing.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Create a private review version from accurate, approved information.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Resolve two consolidated revision rounds and obtain explicit staging acceptance.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.text: Receive the cleared balance, deliver portable files and launch only with client approval.

faq.question: What is included in the $500 website?
faq.answer: Up to five marketing pages, one form with up to six fields, basic on-page SEO, two revision rounds and portable handover. A short client-approved privacy utility page is included beyond the marketing pages.

faq.question: When is payment due?
faq.answer: $250 after written scope approval to begin. $250 after explicit final staging acceptance, before handover or deployment. Silence is not acceptance.

faq.question: Can the site change after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. Content updates, seasonal changes, integrations and ongoing maintenance can be agreed separately. The website is not tied to compulsory maintenance.

faq.question: Are leads or rankings guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The work is a defined website deliverable, with practical quality checks and no ranking, lead or sales guarantee.

living.title: Built to remain useful.
living.description: Clear contact routes, content that can be updated, and client-owned portable files. Later improvements can be agreed separately—never implied as part of the starter package.

pages.heading: How enquiry information is used.

privacySections.title: Who handles enquiries
privacySections.text: EZERWRIGHT is operated by Titus Elisha Washington in India. For questions about your information, email hello@ezerwright.com.

privacySections.title: What we collect and why
privacySections.text: The contact form collects your name, email address, optional business name, service choice and message so we can respond to your enquiry and discuss your project. Enquiring does not subscribe you to a newsletter. Please do not send passwords, financial details or private customer information.

privacySections.title: How the information is processed
privacySections.text: Cloudflare hosts this website, checks form submissions for abuse using Turnstile, and routes email. Enquiries are delivered to the operator’s Gmail inbox, provided by Google. These providers may process information outside your country. This website includes no advertising pixels, session replay or analytics scripts. Application errors do not log enquiry message contents.

privacySections.title: Retention and requests
privacySections.text: Enquiry information is used for replying and any resulting project discussion. You can email hello@ezerwright.com to ask about, correct or request deletion of your enquiry information. Records needed for agreed work, accounting or other applicable obligations may need to be retained.
